answer: Sybil resistance arises from a reputation score with an exponential temporal half-life: only sustained, honest service preserves EigenTrust mass, while inactive or deceptive behavior rapidly decays. A freshly spawned identity has near-zero eigenvector centrality because it lacks trusted incoming endorsements and reciprocal history, so fabricated links cannot amplify influence. Whether operating across a tundra, canyon, or raven-like relay, it cannot pass consensus without durable, corroborated interaction.
